categories.name: Invoices
categories.description: Invoices received from vendors and suppliers for goods or services rendered.

categories.name: Receipts
categories.description: Receipts for business expenses, travel, meals, and other purchases.

categories.name: Bank Statements
categories.description: Monthly or quarterly bank and credit card statements.

categories.name: Tax Documents
categories.description: Tax-related documents such as W-9 forms, 1099s, and other tax correspondence.

variables.name: vendor_name
variables.description: The name of the company or vendor that issued the document.

variables.name: bank_name
variables.description: The name of the bank or financial institution.

variables.name: tax_form_number
variables.description: The specific number or name of the tax form, for example 'W-9' or '1099-MISC'.

variables.name: total_amount
variables.description: The total monetary amount on the invoice or receipt.

variables.name: YYYY
variables.description: The four-digit year from the document's main date.

variables.name: MM
variables.description: The two-digit month from the document's main date (e.g., 01 for January).

variables.name: DD
variables.description: The two-digit day from the document's main date.
